_fixture.description: A DOCUMENT (not a definition) whose footerTemplate is a function and which holds a CanvasElement. toDefinition is strict by default: it fails, listing both nodes with locations, and writes nothing. With onUnrepresentable 'drop' it returns a definition of the rest plus one `dropped` note each; that result is not a faithful copy and the round-trip guarantee does not apply. Each core builds the document from `recipe` in its own idiom.

settings.footerTemplate: function of the page number returning TextBlock('Page N')
